description.value: Many engineers create automatons capable of performing a host of duties. Unless granted a Master Upgrade, all automatons are unintelligent constructs that follow the engineer's instructions unfailingly. At 5th level and every five levels thereafter, the engineer upgrades an Automaton they currently possess to represent his growing skill and power (Upgrade 1 at 5th, Upgrade 2 at 10th, Upgrade 3 at 15th, Master Upgrade at 20th). Upgrades must be performed in order and the engineer must meet the level requirements for the upgrade. The capabilities granted by previous upgrades remain and stack with any improvements granted by the new upgrade. If an Automaton is destroyed, the engineer must rebuild from scratch, costing him 100 gil per engineer level in material components, plus 200 gil per upgrade. Remaking a destroyed Automaton requires 8 hours of uninterrupted work, plus 8 hours for each upgrade. Upon creation, the engineer chooses a base form (Aquatic, Humanoid, Quadruped/Tracked/Wheeled, or Serpentine); this form may not be altered upon subsequent upgrades. The Automaton advances using the Automaton Base Statistics table, gaining Armor Plating at 1st level, Share Trick at 2nd/7th/12th/17th level, Ability Score Increase at 4th/9th/14th/20th level, and Magic Attacks at 4th level. All automatons possess Construct Traits, making them vulnerable to critical hits (DC 15 Fortitude save or be stunned/staggered) and lightning (150% damage).
